name: StatCard
purpose: Displays a single key metric — a label, a large value, and an optional trend delta — for dashboard KPI rows.
neverUseFor: Multi-metric comparisons in one tile — use a Table or chart instead
Interactive/clickable metrics that navigate elsewhere — if it needs a click target, compose a Button around it explicitly rather than making the whole card implicitly clickable
Real-time streaming values without a static fallback — StatCard has no built-in loading/skeleton state in v1

anatomy.description: Composes Card internally — StatCard is not its own elevated surface, it reuses Card's fill/border/radius/shadow.
Up/down trend arrow, rendered via Icon.

props.name: value
props.description: The metric's value, already formatted by the consumer, e.g. '103', '89%'.

props.name: delta
props.description: Change text shown next to the trend icon, e.g. '+2 vs last month'.

props.name: trend
props.description: Direction of the delta — controls the icon (arrow up/down) and its semantic color (success/danger). Omit to render delta as plain text with no icon.

wcag: 1.4.1 Use of Color (trend must also be conveyed by the arrow direction and +/- sign in delta text, never color alone)
